notes:
v1.13.0 Release:
- Dub Whole Series keeps going after a power cut, a crash, lost Wi-Fi or closing the app: each part's tabs and exports are saved as it works. When the app opens again it continues where it stopped (hands-free: by itself after a minute) and does not dub a part again
- Wi-Fi switched off or on during an export no longer fails the export or blocks the next ones
- Every subtitle on screen has a voice: lines Transcribe missed get their own line
- Voices fill the actor's time at Edge's own pace instead of ending early, and short lines stay above loud music; music that is loud all the way through a tab is turned down
- Exported colours match the editor's preview (no washed-out picture with a color filter)
- Finding the burned-in subtitles is about a third faster
- Clone Voices: Transcribe names who speaks from the picture, and each character keeps their name and voice across episodes
- VoxCPM2 switched off: every line is voiced by Piseth or Sreymom by its right gender again

Also new since v1.6.0:
- v1.12.0: one voice per character, faster blur exports, overlays and ads removed
- v1.11.0: VoxCPM2 lines said like the actor, 4x faster lines, better Khmer reading
- v1.10.0: the export matches the editor
- v1.9.0: emotions for imported SRTs and on the voice pill, VoxCPM2 Khmer voice, series export folder
- v1.8.0: VoxCPM2 voice capture and voice groups, Fix Rushed Lines, Khmer pronouns
- v1.7.0: Khmer interface, Join into one video, Gemini model changes
